# Public data outside the competition pack (not included)

- `scad/`: Statistics Centre Abu Dhabi (SCAD) monthly hotel releases (2023 to March 2026), used for the room count
  behind occupancy points and for the March 2026 replay by world region. Download them from scad.gov.ae.
- `research/`: the research notes behind the sourced scenario presets. Every route and event they use is
  already cited in `data/reference/` (each row has its source).
